description.value: Victoria Butterfly Gardens is a year-round tropical jungle attraction on the Saanich Peninsula, located just minutes from Butchart Gardens in Brentwood Bay. Visitors stroll through lush indoor gardens and encounter free-flying butterflies, flamingos, blue-and-gold macaws, tortoises, poison dart frogs, a Cuvier's dwarf caiman, and more. It is accessible from downtown Victoria by BC Transit bus, making it a reachable side-trip for touring cyclists on the peninsula.
